## About
London Auto Werks is a car repair shop in Peoria that specializes in Volkswagen and Audi. Focusing on those makes lets our team better meet your service needs, from routine oil changes to transmission and direct shift gear work.
Our commitment is simple: give you the best solution, never sell you a part or service you don't need, and treat you like family. Jason, the owner, and his team have earned a 4.7 rating from 89 Google reviews, and a longtime customer says she drives in from Gilbert just for maintenance and repairs.

## Services
- Tire rotations, brake pads and fluid flushes: Tire rotations, brake pads, fluid flushes, mileage service and anything else your car needs to keep running.
- Oil changes: Oil changes for all engine sizes, with a fluid top off, tire pressure check and adjust, and a vehicle inspection.
- State emissions test: Swing by before your state emissions test and we'll get you checked out. Already have a list of needed repairs? Bring it in and we'll take care of it.
- Finding the solution: Clunking, jerking or squeaking down the road? Something feel off? Call or come in and we'll take a look and find the solution.
- Transmissions and DSG: We also specialize in automatic and manual transmissions, including direct shift gear (DSG) boxes.
- AC to stay cool: Have your AC checked so you stay cool through the hot Arizona seasons.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can you work with my extended warranty or insurance?
A: Yes. We can honor your extended warranty and we work with most insurance companies.

Q: I already have a quote from another shop. Can you take a look?
A: Yes. A reviewer said Jason offered to look at her car himself so he could give her a more accurate quote.
